title: Impact door at close: sweep the closing feature's decisions, block on surviving citation hits
action: Per plan v2 kds-2 (D1b). build_impact_door in close.rs, stub-independent: (1) collect the closing feature's decision ids by reading .bee/decisions.jsonl for decide events whose feature field (kds-1) equals the closing feature — structured field ONLY, no time-window fallback (recorded deviation: pre-kds-1 decisions are kds-4/campaign debt). (2) For each id call sweep_decision_citations (render.rs:419), then EXCLUDE hits in docs/decisions/index.md, docs/history/<closing-feature>/, and the write-guard's generated-tree list (find its path list in hooks/write_guard and reuse, never hand-copy — if reuse is impossible name the deviation on the cap). (3) Any surviving hit => Door{blocking:true} with detail lines file:line + remedy: fix or annotate the citing doc and re-run close (the sweep re-runs fresh, a fixed doc clears itself). Recorded-deferral escape identical in shape to has_knowledge_freshness_deferral_decision (close.rs:687), tag impact-deferral. (4) Slot after the knowledge-freshness door: exit chain region close.rs:1403-1418 and all three doors vecs (close.rs:1182, 1232, 1301) plus the refusal branch listing.
